name: Tug tiebreak
summary: A 10-second tap war for a tied vote: two camps on a rope over a mud puddle, friends who aren't here pull at their usual strength, the losers slide into the mud and the winner's plan posts.
useWhen: a vote stuck at a tie: 'bowling vs karaoke, 3–3, nobody budging'
two options, two camps, and the chat wants it settled fast and a little physically
dontUseWhen: more than two options (use a poll or claw-pick)
nobody has picked a side yet (use a poll)
a decision that shouldn't come down to tapping speed

params.title: string
params.rule: footnote on the result, e.g. No rematches, Will
params.sides: exactly 2 x {name, icon: pin|mic|ball|star, plan (what posts if they win), team: {name, grip (pulls over the whole war when they aren't tapping)}[]}
